_comment: Bean sfhr. The three defects the bean names (70c7 empty body, 52dz folded title, nvbr blocked on a scrapped bean) plus the five the same readers found beside them, as they stood on 2026-09-20. sfhr is explicit that these are repaired BY THEIR OWNERS and that the bean does not edit them, so the check lists them and fails only on a NEW one. Remove an entry when its bean is repaired; check-bean-bodies reports an entry that no longer matches as stale, so the baseline shrinks rather than fossilises. 2026-09-21, bean sfhr again: the shadow-checklist reader added five more, each an OPEN bean whose canonical Done-when reads unticked while a copy below it reads ticked — 0hi8, 81t5, ivfw, jbx2, xgd8. Same rule: their owners repair them, the check fails only on a new one. b963 is NOT baselined: it had the same defect and it is this session's own bean, so it was ticked in place instead.
